text: 🇲🇽🌎 Mexico's position on the USMCA is already signed: extend it another 16 years. "I already signed Mexico's position: that it be extended another 16 years. What can happen is in the treaty — it's not somebody's whim." — President Claudia Sheinbaum The trilateral USMCA review meeting is set for July 1. Mexico and Canada are both asking for a 16-year extension. If Washington declines, the treaty stays in force under its built-in 10-year review schedule. Mexico negotiates from the text, not from pressure.

🇲🇽🌎 US WON'T EXTEND USMCA — MEXICO AND CANADA ALREADY SIGNED FOR 16 MORE YEARS

Reuters: Washington will announce it won't extend the T-MEC, starting the treaty's 10-year annual-review clock toward a possible 2036 expiry. Mexico and Canada both signed letters to extend the pact 16 years; the US didn't. Sheinbaum, unbothered: "It's not that on July 1 it ends" — a third negotiating round is already set for the week of July 20. After 32 years of North American free trade, it's Washington wavering on certainty, not Mexico.

🇲🇽🏥 MEXICO'S FREE HIV SYSTEM: 95% OF DIAGNOSED ON TREATMENT, AIMING TO END THE EPIDEMIC BY 2030

Of roughly 430,000 people living with HIV in Mexico, 70% are diagnosed and 95% of those are on free antiretroviral treatment — 95% of them with suppressed, untransmittable viral loads. Health Secretary David Kershenobich is pushing free testing across all 32 states, plus free PrEP and PEP. "A person with undetectable viral load does not transmit the virus" — treatment as prevention. Mexico's target: eliminate HIV as a public health problem by 2030, medicine free and nationwide.

🔥🇲🇽 MEXICO AND US FINANCIAL UNITS PUT 39 CASINO GROUPS UNDER THE MICROSCOPE

Mexico's UIF and the US OFAC are jointly scrutinizing 39 authorized casino and betting groups for laundering drug money — seven casinos already sanctioned, including two Grupo Salinas (TV Azteca) operations, plus houses tied to the Sinaloa and Northeast cartels. Owners under review include Jorge Hank Rhon's Grupo Caliente, Televisa and Grupo Imagen. In 2025 alone these operators paid 6 billion pesos in fines and coughed up 74 billion pesos in back taxes. The 4T audits the casino empire the old regime never touched.

🔥🇲🇽 THE BILLIONAIRES FIGHTING MEXICO'S FERTILIZER PLANT AREN'T GREEN — THEY'RE COMPETITORS

Contralínea: the loudest opponents of the 95%-complete Topolobampo ammonia plant — built to produce 2,200 tons of fertilizer a day — are Fertilizantes Tepeyac, owned by the Robinson Bours family (Grupo Bachoco, a $3.6 billion fortune, Mexico's largest fertilizer supplier). The same Bachoco that Profepa shut down in December for clearing 23 hectares of protected Yucatán forest without permits. Sheinbaum notes the plant already passed its environmental study and indigenous consultation — 11 of 15 communities consented. "Environmental concern" dressed up as market defense.

🇲🇽🌎 MEXICO LOCKS CLIMATE GOALS INTO A BUDGETED PLAN — 35% RENEWABLES BY 2030

Mexico adopted its Programa Especial de Cambio Climático 2026-2030, turning pledges into budgeted, verifiable targets for every ministry: emissions to peak at 364-404 million tons of CO2e — a cut of more than 50% against business-as-usual — 35% renewable electricity by 2030, and a 40% reduction in deforestation. Approved unanimously by the climate cabinet under Environment Secretary Alicia Bárcena, as unconditional commitments. No waiting on rich-country money.

🇲🇽🌎 VULCAN'S CALICA MINE IS DONE — "EXTRACTING MORE LIMESTONE IS NO LONGER AN OPTION"

Mexico is negotiating to permanently cancel US firm Vulcan Materials' limestone extraction at Calica, Quintana Roo. Sheinbaum says the company must finance environmental restoration of the protected land it gutted, and the port it once held exclusively stays closed to its mining: "extracting more limestone is no longer an option." Vulcan is fighting back through international arbitration — Mexico isn't blinking.

BBC/REUTERS: USMCA's "looming deadline" — Mexico pushes for a 16-year extension
June 30, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Wire and BBC coverage frames the July 1 review as a deadline hanging over Mexico and leads with Trump's threats — while Mexico and Canada have already signed a letter requesting a clean 16-year renewal to 2042.

🇲🇽 USMCA compliance climbed past 80% in 2026 and Mexico is now the top supplier of goods to the US — leverage the "deadline" framing leaves out.

• Sheinbaum: the extension is "not a new or arbitrary proposal" — the treaty already contemplates it
• Trump "does not intend to renew the agreement in its current form"

REUTERS: Mexico's Sheinbaum vows no protection for ex-Pemex chief after wife posts alleged abuse video
June 29, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Reuters ran it straight: Sheinbaum dropped a longtime ally — ex-Pemex head Víctor Rodríguez — the day his wife posted surveillance video of his abuse, quoting the president directly with no editorializing.

🇲🇽 A government that publicly cuts loose a powerful insider over domestic violence is the story; watch which US outlets reframe it as a "Morena scandal" instead.

• Sheinbaum: "Let the law be applied, we will not protect anyone."
• "There can be no violence against women."

NATIONAL REVIEW: Cracks Begin to Show in the Mexican Regime
June 30, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Joshua Treviño labels Mexico's elected government "the regime" and frames a sovereign decision — not handing citizens over on US indictments without extradition due process — as a "crisis."

🇲🇽 Declining to arrest people on a foreign government's say-so is not a "crack." It is how extradition law works in every sovereign state.

• "DOJ indictments of alleged Mexican narco-politicians from Morena — and the Mexican president's refusal to detain them — are leading to a crisis."
